title: Chrona time observation origin (v1)
description: Receiver-owned contract (CHRONA-AGENT-PROVENANCE-REQUIREMENTS CHR-PROV-001, CHR-PROV-008) for the origin of a TimeObservation derived from an agent or other execution. The actor and provenance record shapes are owned by Praxis (RQ-ROS-2026-A001, A002, A013..A015); Chrona validates their shape only and never requires Praxis to be reachable. Self-reported provenance: not authentication, not authorization, not evidence (CHR-PROV-005). Unknown fields are preserved.

version.description: Semantic version of this contract. Any minor/patch of major 1 is accepted.

sourceSystem.description: Namespaced system that supplied the observation, e.g. praxis.

originExecution.description: Execution that produced the observation: Praxis EXE-<timestamp>-<random>, foreign EXE-<system>.<run>, or CTB-... for a non-agent actor outside any run. Stored as supplied; never dereferenced.

provenance.description: Optional Praxis provenance interchange record (contract praxis.provenance-record), carried verbatim. Structural rules are enforced by the contract codec, not by this schema.

allOf.description: An agent origin must name the execution (EXE-...) that produced it.

actor.description: Praxis actor shape (RQ-ROS-2026-A001). provider/model/runtime are omitted for a human and the literal unknown when not known.

originLineageEntry.description: One entry of an activity's originLineage (CHR-PROV-006): the source observation/activity and its origin, verbatim.
